title: Using variables in place of numbers

cues.en: Now that you know the basics of using python as a calculator it's time to take your skills to the next level.
cues.zh: 現在你已經知道把 Python 當計算機的基本用法，是時候讓技巧更上一層樓了。

cues.en: And that's going to be done by creating variables in python. A variable is a letter or a set of letters
cues.zh: 方法就是在 Python 裡建立變數。變數是一個字母，或一組字母，

cues.en: that is a place holder for a number and I'll show you what that means on the next slide and in a few moments in Python.
cues.zh: 用來代表一個數字。下一張投影片，以及稍後的 Python 示範，會說明這是什麼意思。

cues.en: In this video, you are also going to get to see how to print multiple answers in the same cell of code.
cues.zh: 這段影片也會介紹，如何在同一個程式碼儲存格裡印出多個答案。

cues.en: And if that doesn't really make sense yet what this means and why that's useful then don't worry.
cues.zh: 如果還不懂這是什麼、為什麼有用，別擔心，

cues.en: This will all become clearer in a few moments.
cues.zh: 等一下就會更清楚。

cues.en: Now first let me explain what I mean by variables in Python. You can use variables as placeholders for numbers.
cues.zh: 先解釋 Python 的變數。你可以用變數來代替數字。

cues.en: For example you can say that the variable x equals the number four.
cues.zh: 例如，設定變數 x 等於數字 4。

cues.en: So whenever you see X in an equation you simply replace that with four.
cues.zh: 之後在算式裡看到 x，就把它換成 4。

cues.en: So for example x plus five equals nine.
cues.zh: 例如，x 加 5 等於 9。

cues.en: And this statement is true because x equals four.
cues.zh: 這個敘述成立，因為 x 等於 4。

cues.en: Likewise I can say X divided by two which really means four divided by two equals two.
cues.zh: 同樣地，x 除以 2，實際就是 4 除以 2，等於 2。

cues.en: Now in these very simple cases you can say that using a variable really isn't necessary.
cues.zh: 在這麼簡單的情況，你可能會說，其實沒有必要用變數。

cues.en: And that's true for these very simple cases.
cues.zh: 對，這些非常簡單的例子確實如此。

cues.en: But as you move to more and more sophisticated and advanced applications and mathematics, variables are going to become increasingly important.
cues.zh: 但到了越來越複雜、進階的應用和數學，變數就會越來越重要。

cues.en: OK.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So let's switch to Python and see how to create variables and assign them to be numbers
cues.zh: 切換到 Python，看看如何建立變數，並把數字指定給它。

cues.en: it's actually very simple and very straightforward.
cues.zh: 其實非常簡單、直接。

cues.en: All you do is type the letter that you want to use, the variable, and you say equals seven.
cues.zh: 只要輸入想用的字母，也就是變數，再寫等於 7。

cues.en: So now I can say X equals seven.
cues.zh: 現在可以寫 x=7。

cues.en: I'm gonna run this cell of code by pressing control enter.
cues.zh: 我按 Ctrl+Enter，執行這個儲存格。

cues.en: Now notice that nothing happened.
cues.zh: 注意，什麼都沒發生。

cues.en: This was a little bit different from the previous video where you saw that I implemented some equation and the number, the result of the equation, printed out below.
cues.zh: 這和上一段影片有點不同。之前寫下算式，計算結果會顯示在下方。

cues.en: In this case I'm putting a complete assignment and a complete line of code here and there's nothing to output.
cues.zh: 這次是一個完整的指定敘述、一整行程式碼，沒有東西需要輸出。

cues.en: So Python doesn't do anything but I can type x all by itself in a line like this.
cues.zh: 所以 Python 沒有顯示任何結果，但我可以單獨在一行寫下 x。

cues.en: And now Python runs this line of code and then it sees this line of code and says well I'm not setting
cues.zh: Python 先執行這行，再看到這行，發現並沒有把，

cues.en: any X to be equal to anything so I'm just going to print out the value of x, which is seven of course because that's what I specified.
cues.zh: x 設成任何值，所以就印出 x 的值。當然是 7，因為剛才就是這樣設定的。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So now I'm going going to press shift enter to give me a new cell.
cues.zh: 按 Shift+Enter，新增一個儲存格。

cues.en: And now just like I showed in the slide you can use this variable in place of a number so I can say X minus two.
cues.zh: 如投影片所示，可以用變數取代數字，例如 x 減 2。

cues.en: Now I know that this is going to be five because seven minus two equals five.
cues.zh: 我知道結果會是 5，因為 7 減 2 等於 5。

cues.en: And we confirm that in Python.
cues.zh: Python 也證實了。

cues.en: Now what if you don't like the number seven anymore. You've changed your mind about the number seven and you want to set X equal to some other number.
cues.zh: 如果你不喜歡 7 了，改變心意，想把 x 設為其他數字，怎麼辦？

cues.en: No problem.
cues.zh: 沒問題，

cues.en: It's really really easy.
cues.zh: 非常容易。

cues.en: You just reassign the value of x to be in this case 10.
cues.zh: 重新把 x 的值指定為，例如 10。

cues.en: So now type X again.
cues.zh: 再輸入 x，

cues.en: And now we get X equals 10 and it gets even better than this because I can set X to be equal itself plus some operation.
cues.zh: 現在 x 就是 10。更棒的是，也能把 x 設為它本身再做一些運算。

cues.en: So I'm gonna say X equals X, itself, minus let's say two times five.
cues.zh: 例如，x 等於 x 本身，減去 2 乘以 5。

cues.en: Now if we look at the right hand side of this equation we see that X is Well initially it was seven but then I reset it to be 10.
cues.zh: 看這個式子的右邊，x 原本是 7，但後來改設為 10。

cues.en: So this is gonna be ten minus two times five which is ten.
cues.zh: 所以這裡是 10 減去 2 乘以 5，而 2 乘以 5 是 10。

cues.en: So now the new value of X should be equal to zero.
cues.zh: 因此，x 的新值應該是 0。

cues.en: And now here's something interesting I can run this cell of code again and now X is going to be equal to minus 10.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，可以再執行一次這個儲存格，這次 x 會等於 -10。

cues.en: So when I first ran this line of code the value of X was changed to zero.
cues.zh: 第一次執行這行時，x 的值變成 0。

cues.en: But now I ran it again and now X was zero.
cues.zh: 再執行一次，這時 x 已經是 0，

cues.en: So then this became zero minus 10.
cues.zh: 所以變成 0 減 10。

cues.en: So then the new value of X became zero minus ten which is minus 10 so this is for one variable x.
cues.zh: x 的新值就成為 0 減 10，也就是 -10。以上是一個變數 x 的情況。

cues.en: We can set multiple variables.
cues.zh: 我們也能設定多個變數。

cues.en: So I'm gonna say x equals 10 and Y equals 20.
So now I have two variables in the python workspace.
cues.zh: Python 工作區裡就有兩個變數了。

cues.en: So now I'm gonna write X plus Y times Z.
cues.zh: 接著寫 x 加 y 乘以 z。

cues.en: Now this is interesting. I haven't yet defined any variables called Z or maybe call this letter Z.
cues.zh: 有趣的是，我還沒定義叫 z 的變數。這個字母你也許唸 zee 或 zed，

cues.en: Depending on which country you're from.
cues.zh: 取決於來自哪個國家。

cues.en: So let's see what happens if I try to use a variable that I haven't defined.
cues.zh: 試試使用尚未定義的變數會發生什麼。

cues.en: So we get an error message in Python and the error message.
cues.zh: Python 出現錯誤訊息，而這個訊息，

cues.en: In this case is very useful and informative error message.
cues.zh: 相當有幫助，也提供了清楚資訊。

cues.en: It says the name z, so the variables z, is not defined.
cues.zh: 它說，名稱 z，也就是變數 z，尚未定義。

cues.en: Now this error message is actually really easy to fix.
cues.zh: 這個錯誤很容易修正。

cues.en: We can create a new variable called Z and let's set it to be.
cues.zh: 建立一個叫 z 的新變數，把它設為，

cues.en: How about I know you're thinking I'm going to set it to be 30 but I'm going to do it to be 31.
cues.zh: 我知道你以為我要設成 30，但我偏要用 31，

cues.en: Just to be a little bit different.
cues.zh: 稍微不一樣一點。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And now we get six hundred and thirty.
cues.zh: 現在就得到 630。

cues.en: There's one more thing I want to tell you about variables in this video before moving on to the print function. So far in all these cases, I've been using single letters for
cues.zh: 進入 print 函數前，還想補充一點變數的事。目前這些例子，我都用單一字母，

cues.en: variables and that can be useful sometimes that's also consistent with how you would see variables used in a typical math course.
cues.zh: 當變數。有時這很實用，也符合一般數學課裡變數的寫法。

cues.en: But we can have more informative variables so I'm going to say for example let's say Mike equals ten and how about... what's another good name...
cues.zh: 但也能用更有意義的名稱。例如 Mike 等於 10，再來，還有什麼好名字？

cues.en: How about Spike equals thirty four.
cues.zh: Spike 等於 34 如何？

cues.en: Now there is nothing different about Mike and Spike compared to X and Y.
cues.zh: Mike、Spike 和 x、y 並沒有什麼差別，

cues.en: There's still variables there's still place holders for these numbers.
cues.zh: 仍然是變數，用來代表這些數字。

cues.en: They're just more informative. I can write Mike plus Spike and that's going to give me forty four and this is really powerful because once you start
cues.zh: 只是名稱更有意義。寫 Mike 加 Spike，就得到 44。這個功能很強大，因為當你開始，

cues.en: writing more complicated Python code you're going to want to use more informative names. So you can say
cues.zh: 寫更複雜的 Python 程式，就會想用更能表達意義的名稱。例如，

cues.en: for example number of chocolate bars.
cues.zh: 巧克力棒的數量。

cues.en: So this is a pretty informative variable name number of chocolate bars equals 10.
cues.zh: 這是很清楚的變數名稱，巧克力棒的數量等於 10。

cues.en: I hope that's not the number of chocolate bars you eat everyday that's a little bit unhealthy.
cues.zh: 希望這不是你每天吃的巧克力棒數量，那有點不健康。

cues.en: How about point five.
cues.zh: 改成 0.5 如何？

cues.en: I think half of a chocolate bar per day is a pretty reasonable amount of chocolate.
cues.zh: 我想，每天半條巧克力棒，應該是滿合理的份量。

cues.en: Okay so I want to go back up to this cell here.
cues.zh: 好，回到上面這個儲存格。

cues.en: I specified x y and z so we found out that X plus Y times Z equals six hundred and thirty.
cues.zh: 這裡設定了 x、y、z，算出 x 加 y 乘以 z 等於 630。

cues.en: And I wonder what X minus Y times that is equal to now.
cues.zh: 現在我想知道 x 減 y 乘以 z 等於多少。

cues.en: If you're just looking at this cell, looking at the code here, you might expect two numbers to print out six hundred and thirty and then whatever this answer ends up being.
cues.zh: 只看這裡的程式碼，你可能以為會印出兩個數字：630，以及這個式子的答案。

cues.en: However when I run this cell by pressing control enter we see only one number
cues.zh: 但按 Ctrl+Enter 執行，卻只看到一個數字，

cues.en: printing out. And that is minus six hundred and ten, which corresponds to this second piece of code here.
cues.zh: 印出來，那就是 -610，對應這裡的第二段程式碼。

cues.en: So in python, in these cells, the output here is the output of the final line of code in the cell.
cues.zh: Python 這些儲存格的輸出，是儲存格最後一行程式碼的結果。

cues.en: Now if you want to see both of these you can use the print function. So to use the print function you type print and then in parentheses the answer that you want to print out.
cues.zh: 如果想看兩個答案，可以用 print 函數。寫 print，再把想印出的結果放進括號。

cues.en: So here I wrote print and now I press control enter and I get this 630 answer
cues.zh: 這裡寫好 print，按 Ctrl+Enter，就會印出 630，

cues.en: printed out, and then I get this printed out because this is the last line this ends up being the output of this cell.
cues.zh: 再顯示這個結果，因為它是最後一行，也就成為儲存格的輸出。

cues.en: So I can also put a print function here and then we see the numbers six hundred and thirty from this
cues.zh: 這裡也能再放一個 print，就會看到 630，來自這，

cues.en: line this line and six minus six hundred and ten from this line.
cues.zh: 一行，以及這一行的 -610。

cues.en: Now notice that this is a different use of the parentheses compared to using parentheses to group numbers
cues.zh: 注意，這裡的括號用法，和拿括號把數字，

cues.en: or variables, which I already introduced you to in a previous video.
cues.zh: 或變數分成一組不同。後者在上一段影片介紹過。

cues.en: This is sometimes called "overloading" in programming.
cues.zh: 程式設計裡，有時稱為 overloading，也就是多載。

cues.en: It means that we're using the same character, or the same operator, for multiple different functions.
cues.zh: 意思是相同字元，或相同運算子，具有多種不同功能。

cues.en: And you have to know from context which is appropriate. Here are your two exercises for this video.
cues.zh: 你必須根據上下文，判斷適用的意義。以下是這段影片的兩個練習。

cues.en: What you want to do is create these three variables x y and z.
cues.zh: 先建立 x、y、z 三個變數。

cues.en: Set them to be 7 so x equals 7 y equals minus 2 z equals 5.
cues.zh: 把它們設為：x=7、y=-2、z=5。

cues.en: And then you want to implement these two equations here.
cues.zh: 接著實作這裡的兩個算式。

cues.en: So 3 x times the quantity 4 plus y and then minus Y minus X plus 3 over Z.
cues.zh: 3x 乘以括號裡的 4 加 y；以及負 y，減去 x 加 3 再除以 z。

cues.en: And this first equation will equal 42 which is a pretty neat number and this equation will equals zero.
cues.zh: 第一個算式等於 42，是個很棒的數字；另一個等於 0。

cues.en: So now you should pause the video, switch to Python on your own and implement these two exercises.
cues.zh: 現在請暫停影片，自己切換到 Python，實作這兩個練習，

cues.en: These two equations. Make sure you get the right answer and then you can come back to the video and watch me solve these problems in Python.
cues.zh: 也就是兩個算式，確認答案正確，再回來看我用 Python 解題。

cues.en: So to start with I'm going to create the three variables so we need X equals seven, Y equals minus two,
cues.zh: 先建立三個變數，需要 x=7、y=-2，

cues.en: and z equals five.
cues.zh: 以及 z=5。

cues.en: So the first equation was three X and then times something else so you might be initially tempted to say three X times four plus y.
cues.zh: 第一個式子是 3x 再乘上一個東西，你可能一開始會直接寫 3x 乘以括號裡的 4 加 y。

cues.en: Now if you're writing out math in the way I showed in the slide or the way you would see in a textbook the way you would write it on a piece of paper with a pencil it actually does look like this.
cues.zh: 如果按照投影片、課本，或用筆在紙上寫數學式，確實就是這種寫法。

cues.en: You don't have to put a multiplication operator in between the three and the X or in between the x and the parentheses.
cues.zh: 3 和 x 之間，以及 x 和括號之間，都不必寫乘法運算子。

cues.en: However, this is not the right way to do it in Python.
cues.zh: 但在 Python 裡，這樣寫不對，

cues.en: As you learned in the previous video.
cues.zh: 如上一段影片所學。

cues.en: So you need parentheses to indicate multiplication.
cues.zh: 所以，需要用括號來表示乘法。

cues.en: All right.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: So that gives us an answer of forty two.
cues.zh: 答案是 42。

cues.en: I'm actually going to print this out here because I want to put the next line of code directly under.
cues.zh: 我把結果用 print 印出來，因為想把下一行程式直接寫在下面。

cues.en: I'm going to say minus Y minus.
cues.zh: 先寫負 y，再減去，

cues.en: And then this was x plus three divided by Z.
cues.zh: x 加 3，除以 z。

cues.en: And again if you wrote out something like this then.
cues.zh: 如果你寫成這樣，

cues.en: Good job trying but this is unfortunately not really correct, because python is gonna associate three divided by Z and then separately add that to X.
cues.zh: 願意嘗試很好，但可惜不正確，因為 Python 會把 3 除以 z 放在一起，再另外加上 x。

cues.en: We need to tell Python explicitly that the X plus the three go together in the numerator of this fraction,
cues.zh: 必須明確告訴 Python，x 加 3 要一起放在這個分數的分子，

cues.en: and that we do with parentheses and then we get a value of 0 which is the correct answer.
cues.zh: 用括號就能做到。得到的值是 0，這才是正確答案。

cues.en: In this video you learned how to use variables in Python as place holders for numbers.
cues.zh: 這段影片學到了，如何在 Python 裡用變數來代表數字。

cues.en: You can have variables be single letters like X or Y, or you can have them be longer more meaningful strings like you know the number of chocolate bars.
cues.zh: 變數可以是 x、y 這種單一字母，也能是更長、更有意義的名稱，例如巧克力棒的數量。

cues.en: And I also showed you in this video how to print out multiple answers in the same cell of code. In the next video,
cues.zh: 也示範了如何在同一個儲存格印出多個答案。下一段影片，

cues.en: you're going to learn how to print out multiple answers that look really nice and nicer than the default Python output.
cues.zh: 會教你印出好看的多個答案，比 Python 預設輸出更漂亮。
